reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Aston Villa FC are favoured at 51%, against 28% for Galatasaray SK and 21% for the draw. Aston Villa FC carry 106 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Galatasaray SK 1.2 points per game, Aston Villa FC 2.4. They average 1.5 points per game on the road this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 4.04 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 77%. Across their last five, Galatasaray SK and Aston Villa FC have scored 2.3 and conceded 2.1 a game between them. Aston Villa FC are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Galatasaray SK.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
